correction.why: The autopilot deduplicated deaths on integer distance, so any run ending at the same distance as the previously recorded one was not counted. The trace holds 15 distinct run ids, i.e. 14 restarts. Fixed in agent/autopilot.js by counting on the playing->over edge.
correction.note: deaths.json for this run is therefore incomplete: it holds the 10 rows that were recorded, and deaths_by_verdict is derived from those, so it undercounts in the same proportion. The run predates the three-lane game and cannot be regenerated.
